nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I'm waving behind a defender?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll wave back.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Give the player on the ball an option they can actually use.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: End of week 5.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Week 6. At training, Sam opens the team rankings on a phone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here's where we are.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And where we want to be?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Higher. Very advanced analysis.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Team Training.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Space ahead. A teammate available. What do you do?

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: A useful pass might be available now. Carrying might improve the picture. Look at the pressure, the space, and what your teammate can do next.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Don't wait for a tackle to tell you it was time to pass.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Look again. What was available before the pressure arrived?

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Good choice. Now get the weight right.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: You used what the defender gave you.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Code finishes giving you feedback. Blake waits until Coach walks away.

nodes.speaker: Blake
nodes.text: You getting a private lesson or what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I asked a question. You can do that.

nodes.speaker: Blake
nodes.text: Don't get comfortable. You're still new.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You keep reminding me.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Sam approaches.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Coming?

nodes.speaker: Blake
nodes.text: Ask Coach's favorite.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Blake grabs a bag and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's a yes. Just with issues.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Weekly minigame.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Home.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: League Game 4.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Carry with a purpose. Pass with a purpose. Then help again.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Development checkpoint.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Same target next week?

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: End of week 6.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Week 7. School. Blake checks the player rankings on a phone. Sam looks over.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Checking your ranking?

nodes.speaker: Blake
nodes.text: Checking why everyone's getting excited about theirs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could just follow me.

nodes.speaker: Blake
nodes.text: Let's see that other foot first.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Weird thing to ask at lunch.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Weekly minigame.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Team Training. Code sets up a receiving situation with pressure closing one side.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Your favorite foot isn't always the useful one. Open your body. See what's available.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: We're building options. Don't force the weaker foot when it makes no sense—but don't lose a good option because you're afraid to use it.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: You took an extra touch to get comfortable. What closed while you waited?

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Right idea. Slow the repetition down and clean it up.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: You kept the option open. That's why we practice both.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Home.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: League Game 5.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Both feet coming today?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Depends how this warm-up goes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Use the option the game gives you. Help each other.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: End of week 7.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Week 8. Training field. Sam glances toward the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Blake's late.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe stuck admiring the rankings.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hasn't answered the group chat either.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Bring it in. Let's get started.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Sam puts the phone away. Blake's spot stays empty.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Development checkpoint.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Team Training.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Looking early, a useful first touch, a good decision, then movement. Today we connect them.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: One good action doesn't finish your job. Pass it, then become useful again.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Start with the information. Find the pressure before you rush the next action.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: You've shown you can do it. Now we work on repeating it.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: You're connecting the actions. Keep doing it when the pressure changes.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Weekly minigame.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Home.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: League Game 6. Blake is back.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Last league game before the tournament. Play this opponent—not the rankings.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Blake approaches while you and Sam pack your bags.

nodes.speaker: Blake
nodes.text: I'm moving to Next Horizon.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Since when?

nodes.speaker: Blake
nodes.text: It's sorted. I'm going somewhere that wins.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You practice that line?

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Blake shoulders the bag and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Definitely in a mirror.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: End of week 8. Midseason report.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Week 9. School. Sam opens the AZ Showcase field on a phone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Two out-of-state teams in our group.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any good?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's check before you promise a hat trick.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Rankings don't play the game.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good. Mine has terrible stamina.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Team Training.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: New opponents. Same job: find out what's available.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: If they press, look for the option their movement opens. If they stand off, use the space. Don't decide before you've looked.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Weekly minigame.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Home. Tournament preparation.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Packed?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Boots, kit, shin guards.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Water?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That was the next word.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Saturday. The AZ Showcase. Eight teams, two groups of four.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Three games to earn another one. Focus on the game in front of you.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: AZ Showcase, group game 1 of 3. Saturday.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Find one thing we can change. Take it into the next game.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Look at what they took away. Where was the next option?

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Good result. What worked that we can use again?

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: AZ Showcase, group game 2 of 3. Saturday.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Find one thing we can change. Take it into the next game.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Look at what they took away. Where was the next option?

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Good result. What worked that we can use again?

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: AZ Showcase, group game 3 of 3. Sunday.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Find one thing we can change. Take it into the next game.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Look at what they took away. Where was the next option?

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Good result. What worked that we can use again?

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: AZ Showcase final. Sunday.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: End of week 9. Tournament review. Tournament results stay out of the league table.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Week 10. Training field. Code opens the tournament report.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: What kept giving you trouble?

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Good. We've got something specific to work on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can mine be playing better before nine in the morning?

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Start by arriving before nine.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Team Training.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Can you win it? If not, slow the attack and protect the dangerous space.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: The right option still needs the right weight. Give your teammate a ball they can use.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Move where the pass can reach you. Adjust when the picture changes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Find the pressure early. Let your first touch help with it.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Don't learn one setup. Learn what to look for.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Weekly minigame.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Home.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: League Game 7.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ready to see if the homework worked?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Better than showing my working.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Use it when the moment comes. Don't force it.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: End of week 10.
